The '''Arkanian sonic blaster''' was an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] designed [[Sonic pistol|soundwave-based weapon]] manufactured during the period surrounding the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and the [[Jedi Civil War]] that was as powerful as a normal [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] with the added benefit of disorientating the enemy. In addition, many types of [[Personal energy shield/Legends|shields]] and defenses were unable to block sonic attacks.
